mapper.sql: o.id AS observation_id, o.report_id, r.profile_id, o.status, r.processing_status, r.visibility_status, o.metric_definition_id, o.temp_metric_id, o.original_name, o.unit_text
mapper.select: SELECT FROM observation o JOIN report r ON r.id = o.report_id WHERE o.id = #{observationId}

SELECT FROM observation o JOIN report r ON r.id = o.report_id WHERE r.profile_id = #{profileId} AND r.processing_status = 'CONFIRMED' AND o.status = 'FORMAL' AND o.metric_definition_id IS NULL AND o.temp_metric_id IS NULL ORDER BY o.id
SELECT FROM observation o JOIN report r ON r.id = o.report_id WHERE o.report_id = #{reportId} AND o.status = 'FORMAL' AND o.metric_definition_id IS NULL AND o.temp_metric_id IS NULL ORDER BY o.id
mapper.sql: t.id, t.profile_id, t.display_name, t.name_key, t.unit_key, t.unit_text, t.origin_observation_id, t.mapping_status, t.created_at, t.updated_at

, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM observation o JOIN report r ON r.id = o.report_id WHERE o.temp_metric_id = t.id AND o.status = 'FORMAL' AND r.processing_status = 'CONFIRMED' AND r.visibility_status = 'NORMAL') AS observation_count, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM followed_metric f WHERE f.temp_metric_id = t.id) AS followed
mapper.select: SELECT FROM temp_metric t WHERE t.profile_id = #{profileId} ORDER BY t.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO temp_metric (profile_id, display_name, name_key, unit_key, unit_text, origin_observation_id, mapping_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{profileId}, #{displayName}, #{nameKey}, #{unitKey}, #{unitText}, #{originObservationId}, #{mappingStatus}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE observation SET temp_metric_id = NULL WHERE temp_metric_id = #{tempMetricId}
UPDATE temp_metric SET mapping_status = 'MERGED', updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND mapping_status = 'UNMERGED'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM temp_metric t WHERE t.profile_id = #{profileId} ORDER BY t.id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM temp_metric WHERE profile_id = #{profileId} AND id = #{id}
